```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/da52d699-e8d2-4dc5-9191-a2199e0b6a9b.xlsx"

# Word counts as provided

    'Fire and Blood': 398000,
    'Song of Solomon': 102000,
    'The Lost Symbol': 150000,
    '2001: A Space Odyssey': 50000,
    'American Gods': 170000,
    'Out of the Silent Planet': 120000,
    'The Andromeda Strain': 70000,
    'Brave New World': 64000,
    'Silence': 40000,
    'The Shining': 155000
}
# Map counts
df['Word Count'] = df['Title'].map(word_counts)
# Compute words/day
df['Words per Day'] = df['Word Count'] / df['Days']
slowest_row = df.loc[df['Words per Day'].idxmin()]
print("Words/day by title:\n", df[['Title','Days','Word Count','Words per Day']])
print(f"\nSlowest: {slowest_row['Title']} -> {slowest_row['Words per Day']:.2f} words/day")
```
